sloka: परिपूर्णमिवाकाशं सञ्छन्नेव च मेदिनी ।लङ्कामुपनिविष्टैश्च सम्पतद्भिश्च वानरैः ।। ६.४१.४९ ।।।।
transliteration: paripūrṇamivākāśaṁ sañchanneva ca medinī ।laṅkāmupaniviṣṭaiśca sampatadbhiśca vānaraiḥ ।। 6.41.49 ।।।।

translations.english: There it seemed as if a flight of locusts had gathered, with monkey army gathered there. It was amazing and astonishing.
